title: Extension of a compactly supported finite-mass current from U to ℝ^P (G3)
statement: Assume MF (as in support_null). Let P, m ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, K ⊆ U compact and X ∈ D_{m+1}(U) with spt X ⊆ K and M(X) < ∞. Then there is Y ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^P) (a current on univ) with Y.restrictDomain (subset_univ U) = X, spt Y ⊆ K, M(Y) ≤ M(X) and M(∂Y) ≤ M(∂X) (M is the mass on the domain of each current), such that Y is integer multiplicity whenever X is, and ∂Y is integer multiplicity whenever ∂X is.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = ∫⁻ x in M ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U K : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), X.support ⊆ K → X.mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1), Y.restrictDomain (subset_univ U) = X ∧ Y.support ⊆ K ∧ Y.mass ≤ X.mass ∧ Y.boundary.mass ≤ X.boundary.mass ∧ (IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y) ∧ (IsIntegerMultiplicity X.boundary → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y.boundary)
